$comment: CodeQL code-scanning alerts triaged against the code (infra/security/README.md, Accepted findings). Each entry names the alert, its rule and file, a verdict (real: input an outside party or another service chooses reaches the code on a server, or the code was wrong; not_exploitable: it cannot), the reason for the verdict, and what the code does now. An alert is never dismissed on GitHub from here: it closes when a scan no longer finds it. Add an entry with an empty change only for an alert left in place, and say why.
